title: Category Ordering and Reset
intent: Order categorical position domains explicitly or by aggregate summaries and restore first-appearance order when needed.
useWhen: Use this recipe when bar, point, or label order should communicate rank instead of source first appearance.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe when a fixed scale domain already owns the order or when sorting rows rather than categories is required.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: An array of plain row objects containing the fields required by this task.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Task-specific field names, resource identifiers, and supported visual or statistical choices.

outcomes: Order categorical position domains explicitly or by aggregate summaries and restore first-appearance order when needed.

steps.instruction: Create the data, marks, encodings, and owned resources required before authoring the category ordering and reset result.
Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable category ordering and reset result or workflow.
Use the focused lifecycle actions only after their owned category ordering and reset resources exist and are uniquely targeted.

alternatives.when: Choose a neighboring recipe when its stated result and data roles match the requested chart more directly.
alternatives.instruction: Prefer one complete domain facade or task recipe before composing lower-level actions manually.

pitfalls.problem: Implicit targeting fails when several compatible datasets, marks, scales, guides, or owners exist in the same program.
pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.
